scope: Supported-runtime compatibility matrix, desktop startup root cause, minimal runtime fix regression. Not packaged-app or browser business acceptance.

cells.message: Windows Electron tests cannot use Node 24.15.0; use Node 24.16.0 or later (nodejs/node#63620).

cells.detail: renderer ready + agentBrowser.status ok; default-GPU run also passes

cells.note: Main delegates browser work to the CLI child / managed driver; the in-process engine guard protects the standalone and in-process playwright host paths, not the Electron bundle runtime itself.

cells.entry: Electron host bridge browser action without bundled agent-browser
cells.detail: agentBrowser.status reports browserControlEnabled=false; an open attempt returns ok:false with a typed backend error and creates no session; no crash, no leftover process

startupRootCause.symptom: Ordinary E2E launch of Electron exited 0x80000003 (2147483651); ELECTRON_DISABLE_SANDBOX=1 progressed but firstWindow timed out at 30s (hygiene-20261016).
startupRootCause.cause: Playwright-controller-side Windows libuv TCP connect defect (nodejs/node#63620) on Node 24.0-24.15; the controller cannot complete the launch handshake, so Electron is torn down before a window exists.
evidence: control (clean c689f05c2) and candidate (frozen reintegration) behave identically under the same frozen toolchain (N1 matrix 4/4).
Frozen controller Node 24.16.0: default-GPU launch + host invoke pass (desktop-default-gpu.json).
System Node 24.15.0 is rejected by scripts/windows-test-node.mjs before Electron starts; the engine guard rejects it with E_NODE_RUNTIME and 0 browser calls.
startupRootCause.minimalFix: scripts/windows-test-node.mjs pre-flight guard asserted in playwright.config.ts (already present, unit-tested); no product default changed and no permanent --no-sandbox.

minimalRuntimeFix.problem: packages/versebrowser depends on a hash-pinned patch to playwright-core/lib/coreBundle.js (patch-upstream.mjs). The patch was applied by hand in the incumbent checkout but was NOT part of any install/build/package step, so a fresh checkout failed at browser open with E_UPSTREAM_PATCH. machine residue, not reproducible wiring.
minimalRuntimeFix.change: packages/versebrowser/package.json build script is now `node scripts/patch-upstream.mjs && tsc -p tsconfig.build.json`, so postinstall/predev/prebuild:vite all apply the required patch; the script is version-guarded, hash-verified and writes via temp+rename (store-safe).

confirmations.noPermanentNoSandbox: 0 occurrences of --no-sandbox in electron/, packages/, src/, scripts/ product code
confirmations.noLocalDeliveryDependency: no runtime reference to D:/versebrowser or .local; only provenance/audit scripts default VERSEBROWSER_SOURCE_ROOT to D:/versebrowser, and scripts/versebrowser-m10-package-verify.mjs forbids dev paths inside the package
confirmations.frozenDefaultsUnchanged: no product default, permission policy or toolchain pin changed; the only product change is adding the already-existing patch step to the package build
confirmations.diagnosticVsNormal: diagnostic cell uses --no-sandbox only via --diagnostic-no-sandbox; normal cells never pass --no-sandbox

limitations: Not packaged/installed-app acceptance; that is N8.
Electron internal runtime is Node 24.14.0/uv1.51.0 and is not covered by assertBrowserRuntime; the CLI child and managed driver own browser work.
No real-model or MCP evidence here.
